title: SREV-043 dynamic port fixed string

audit_contract.description: API: Ipc_Api_OpenDynamicPort | wire: {"request": "API_OPEN_DYNAMIC_PORT_ARGS", "fields": [{"name": "port_name", "type": "WCHAR*", "required": true, "shape": "NUL-terminated within DYNAMIC_PORT_NAME_CHARS"}, {"name": "port_id", "type": "WCHAR*", "required": false, "shape": "NUL-terminated within DYNAMIC_PORT_ID_CHARS"}, {"name": "filter_num", "type": "ULONG"}, {"name": "filter_ids", "type": "ULONG*"}]}

validation_invariants.description: All contracts listed in the contracts metadata must hold before any data is trusted past the validation boundary

runtime_matrix.description: Windows runtime gate proves contracts hold under normal and malformed inputs

contracts: port_name is required and must be copied before dynamic-port topology uses it
port_name must be readable as DYNAMIC_PORT_NAME_CHARS WCHARs with WCHAR alignment
port_name must be non-empty and NUL-terminated before DYNAMIC_PORT_NAME_CHARS - 1
present port_id must be non-empty and NUL-terminated before DYNAMIC_PORT_ID_CHARS - 1
overlong unterminated fixed strings are invalid and must not be truncated
Ipc_CreateDynamicPort receives only local fixed buffers
